subject: Biotechnology
title: Robotics in Biotech Labs
description: A micro-lesson that makes Robotics in Biotech Labs usable.

hook.text: A robot scientist runs 10,000 experiments per day — lab automation accelerates biotechnology beyond human speed limits.

buildup.text: Liquid handling robots pipette nanoliter volumes with perfect precision — eliminating human error in repetitive lab tasks.

discovery.text: Strateos and Emerald Cloud Lab offer remote laboratories — scientists design experiments online and robots execute them.

twist.text: Automation works for standardized protocols — but creative troubleshooting and unexpected results still need human scientists.

climax.text: AI-guided robotic labs close the loop — the AI analyzes results, designs the next experiment, and the robot runs it autonomously.

punchline.text: Robots pipette, AI thinks — automated labs accelerate discovery around the clock.

quiz.question: What do cloud laboratories like Strateos offer researchers?
options: Free access to all published research papers
Remote access to robotic labs where scientists design experiments online and robots execute them physically
Virtual reality simulations of laboratory experiments
